title: Oklahoma 17, Oklahoma State 7: Bedlam on November 28, 1959
question: What was the score of the Oklahoma vs. Oklahoma State game on November 28, 1959?
answer: Oklahoma beat Oklahoma State 17-7 in Norman on November 28, 1959, scoring 14 points in the fourth quarter. The win closed the Sooners' regular season at 7-3.
summary: On November 28, 1959, Oklahoma closed its season with a 17-7 Bedlam win over Oklahoma State in Norman, pulling away with 14 fourth-quarter points.
body: The Sooners ended the 1959 regular season on Saturday, November 28, by hosting Oklahoma State at Oklahoma Memorial Stadium in Norman. Oklahoma arrived at 6-3 and ranked No. 17, while the Cowboys came in at 6-3 as well, so the Bedlam game had real weight for both sides.

It started as a defensive struggle. Neither team scored in the first quarter. Both teams scored in the second quarter, Oklahoma with a field goal's worth of points and Oklahoma State with a touchdown, so the Cowboys led 7-3 at halftime. The third quarter passed without any points.

The Sooners took over in the fourth, scoring 14 unanswered points to win 17-7. The ground game did the work: Oklahoma ran for 290 of its 348 total yards, while the Cowboys managed just 128 yards of offense. Ron Hartline led the way with 109 yards on 19 carries. Attendance was listed at 59,136.

The victory moved Oklahoma to 7-3 for the year. For fans looking back, the game is a good snapshot of Bud Wilkinson's Sooners: a ground-based attack that wore an opponent down and finished strong when it counted.
